title: Adaptive Evidence-Lite Intake for Low-Risk Compliance Requests (playbook & routing rules)
creator: Asha Patel
description: Problem: Many enterprise security/compliance asks (SOC2 excerpts, basic DPA checks, standard vendor questionnaires) are low-risk but require manual evidence collection that delays responses and consumes engineering/SEC time. Goal: create an adaptive intake flow that automatically routes low-risk requests through an 'Evidence-Lite' lane with pre-approved templates and automated checks, while preserving escalation pathways for high-risk or ambiguous cases. This reduces average response time and frees security/product bandwidth for high-risk/regulated asks.
acceptance_criteria: A1: Intake classifier (rule-based + lightweight ML) identifies >=80% of incoming requests as 'low-risk' or 'needs-escalation' on a live sample of 200 requests with FPR <10% for low-risk labeling.

A2: Evidence-Lite lane provides templated artifacts (SOC2 user access excerpt, data residency summary, DPA signoff checklist) that can be completed by PM/SE without infra changes in <=3 business days.
A3: Automated evidence validation (checksum + doc presence checks + basic metadata assertions) flags mismatches and reduces manual verifications by at least 50% versus baseline.
A4: Escalation workflow routes complex cases to Security with pre-populated context and recommended priority tier in <1 hour after classification.
A5: Metrics emitted to Console: avg response time (low-risk), % auto-closed by Evidence-Lite, and time-to-escalation; dashboard seeded for pilot accounts.
routing_rules: Rule 1: Classifier uses: request_type, keywords (HIPAA, PHI, DPA, GDPR, SOC2), customer_tier, data_category to produce preliminary risk score.
Rule 2: If score <= 0.25 AND requested_artifacts subset of 'supported-lite' => route to Evidence-Lite lane.
Rule 3: If customer_tier == 'enterprise' AND request mentions 'legal' or 'contract amendment' => bypass Evidence-Lite, route to enterprise triage.
Rule 4: Any mention of 'on-prem', 'air-gapped', 'HSM', 'KMS' => mark high risk and route to Security immediately.
Rule 5: Requests with ambiguous keywords trigger human-in-the-loop review after automated pre-fill (48-hour SLA to decision).
evidence_templates: SOC2-Lite: service description excerpt + control owner contact + last test date + link to SOC2 redacted report (if available).
DPA-Checklist: list of DPA clauses, yes/no/conditional answers, ownership pointer (legal/PM), suggested clause text for common exceptions.
Data-Residency Summary: list of regions data is stored, transit encryption scheme, customer-configurable region options.
HIPAA-Summary Card (for low-risk): PHI handling summary, BAAs availability statement, example redaction guidance; for sensitive cases escalate.
Vendor-Questionnaire Quickpack: prefilled answers for 20 most common SaaS questions with links to longer artifacts.
escalation_playbook: Stage 0 (Auto-resolve): If request satisfied with Evidence-Lite templates and automated checks pass => close with templated reply; notify requester and CSM.
Stage 1 (Human review): If automated checks fail or requester asks clarifying question => assign to Security Triage queue (SLA 48h).
Stage 2 (Security investigation): Security lead augments evidence, runs required audits, and escalates to Legal if contractual changes required.
Stage 3 (Exec escalation): For high-impact decisions (data residency exceptions, non-standard BAA) notify Product + Legal + Sales leaders; propose contract amendment template.
automation_notes: Classifier architecture: small transformer fine-tuned on historical intake labels + rules fallback; initial model serves suggestions only (human-in-loop).
Auto-validation: use hash-based checks for immutable artifacts (e.g., redacted SOC2 PDF), metadata parsing for dates and names, and a 'confidence' score surface to reviewers.
Integrations: Confluence drive links, GitHub PR for template content, Zendesk/HubSpot ticket sync for CSM notifications, Console metrics endpoint (OpenTelemetry).
Safety guardrails: Every auto-resolve includes a 30-day audit flag; random sampling of 5% auto-resolved cases for manual QA during pilot.
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - Design (2 weeks): finalize templates, decision matrix, and classifier training dataset (sprint 2026-W10).
Phase 1 - Pilot (4 weeks): enable for low-risk accounts (beta label 'Evidence-Lite') with 3 internal customers and 5 pilot external accounts, run QA sampling.
Phase 2 - Expand (6 weeks): tune thresholds, add more templates, onboard CSM flow and Zendesk automation; monitor metrics and adjust SLA targets.
Phase 3 - GA (post-metrics validation): document runbook, train Security/Support, and include feature in console as 'Fast Compliance Lane'.
